mathematical_checks.PRIME: 30031=59×509; new prime divisor proof uses least divisor, not uniqueness of factorization.
mathematical_checks.IRRATIONAL: Lowest positive fraction a/b plus parity lemma yields both a,b even, contradiction; commensurability equivalent to rational ratio.
mathematical_checks.TRIANGLE: 12×21/2=126; all nondegenerate triangles withpositivebase/altitude: foot inside gives sum of two right triangles, at endpoint gives one right triangle, outside gives difference of right triangles.

term_decisions: ch01 proof/conditional A⇒B/counterexample introduced contextually; no formal mathematical induction.
ch02 sexagesimal notation uses semicolon and commas explicitly, q is local.
ch03 natural numbers include0 book-wide; primes and divisor lemma usepositiveintegers>1.
ch03 rational/irrational, commensurable, postulate/commonnotion/general axiom distinguished.
ch04 Chinese canon/commentary text layers, rule-of-three proportion, positive magnitude versus real roots.
caveats: The British Museum full catalogue failed to open; official search index only is explicitly disclosed. Broad second-millennium date avoids conflict with old 1650 BCE attribution.
Some online primary texts are editions/translations/transcriptions, not ancient originals personally inspected. All footnotes name editions.
No sole inventor of proof, algebra or irrationality claimed; no absence of ancient reasoning inferred from missing or algorithmic texts.
Ch03 Euclidean natural number convention includes0 and ch10 should match.
The book links to manifest chapter names still being written by other agents; missing files are not link typos.
